about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Luz M. Rivas

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END ICE RAIDS
statements.title: END ICE RAIDS
sentences: I am calling for Stephen Miller to be fired and for ICE to be abolished. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE ISSUED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO THE "CALIFORNIA STATE NONROAD ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE ISSUED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO THE "CALIFORNIA STATE NONROAD ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL STANDARDS; COMMERCIAL HARBOR...
sentences: Americans have spent more than $105 billion on gasoline and diesel fuel since the start of Trump's reckless war of choice with Iran, while Trump's Big Oil buddies are raking in record profits.

I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this harmful Republican proposal, and I urge my Republican colleagues to work with us on solutions that will make life more affordable for our constituents instead of, yet again, making Americans sicker and poorer.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING FOR SHUTDOWN OF DILLEY
statements.title: CALLING FOR SHUTDOWN OF DILLEY
sentences: While Republicans continue to let ICE run out of control, working families are struggling to afford basic essentials like groceries.
I visited a Head Start program to learn about how Republicans' cuts make it harder for working families to thrive.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELEASE OF ARMENIAN PRISONERS
statements.title: RELEASE OF ARMENIAN PRISONERS
sentences: Detainees are reported to have suffered from torture and abuse while being denied fundamental legal rights.
I stand with the Armenian-American community, my colleagues, and the families of the detainees in calling for the release and safe return of these prisoners of war.

Birthright Citizenship Mr. Speaker, just moments ago, the Supreme Court struck down Donald Trump's illegal attempt to end birthright citizenship and ruled that 4 million children born in the United States, including many across the San Fernando Valley, have a place in this country as American citizens.
I am proud to cosponsor the Azerbaijan Sanctions Review Act to demand the release of these prisoners and hold officials accountable for these abuses.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GREENHOUSE GAS RESOLUTION
statements.title: GREENHOUSE GAS RESOLUTION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, last September, the Trump administration announced that it would roll back the EPA's Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program, or the GHGRP.
Since 2010, the GHGRP has collected and tracked greenhouse gas emissions from more than 8,000 sites, including landfills, power plants, and oil refineries.
Rolling back the GHGRP will leave environmental justice communities unprepared to address the harmful environmental health and economic impacts of climate change.
It was my honor to invite her as my guest to this year's State of the Union Address.
I also introduced a resolution to protect it from the Trump administration's attacks.
I urge my colleagues to join me in calling for the administration to protect environmental justice communities and halt its rollback of the GHGRP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAN FERNANDO VALLEY MOURNS THE LOSS OF BELINDA BARRAGAN
statements.title: SAN FERNANDO VALLEY MOURNS THE LOSS OF BELINDA BARRAGAN
sentences: For over 30 years, she was at the forefront of public service, advocating for working families and Latinos, ensuring that they had all the opportunities and support to thrive.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
statements.title: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
sentences: We are here because Trump and Republicans led us to a cost-of-living crisis that is making life more unaffordable for working families.
Budgets are a reflection of our values, and Trump made his values heard loud and clear: Leave working families behind.
Trump's budget cuts $73 billion in programs that support working families.
LIHEAP helps environmental justice communities like mine deal with the effect of extreme heat and climate change, and Trump wants to gut $4 billion in funding for LIHEAP.
However, due to climate change, periods of extreme heat in southern California, especially in the San Fernando Valley, are becoming more common, more intense, and more harmful.
Trump's budget proposal does not make life healthier or more affordable for working families in my district and across the country.
Since Trump's war in Iran started, gas prices in Los Angeles County have shot up to an average of nearly $6 per gallon with some gas stations seeing prices as high as $8 per gallon.
Trump's budget request does not bring gas prices down for working families in the San Fernando Valley or across the country.
WIC programs across my district help many of my constituents access the resources that they need for a healthier life, including food vouchers, nutrition education, and healthcare referrals.
Trump wants to continue spending over $1 billion per day to continue his war in Iran while working families in my district and across the country continue to struggle with the rising cost of gas.
As Donald Trump turns his back on working Americans, my Congressional Progressive Caucus colleagues and I are fighting for them and the resources they need to succeed.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
statements.title: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I oppose the Republicans' RED Tape Act because it guts the Clean Air Act and strips the EPA's ability to inform the public of potential health concerns that they will face because of Federal projects.
The Clean Air Act makes sure that the EPA considers the health and environmental impacts of communities before a project begins.
My district has some of the highest asthma rates in the country because of generations of poor land-use decisions.
Trump and Republicans are prioritizing the profits of their billionaire and corporate interest friends over the health of our communities.

There is a reason that all Democrats on the Energy and Commerce Committee voted against the RED Tape Act, and that is because it is a harmful bill for everyone, except for Donald Trump and Republicans' billionaire friends.
This bill will increase levels of air pollution and send more people to the hospital at a time when Republicans have already gutted working families' healthcare.
This bill does not make life safer or more affordable for working families in my district.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on the RED Tape Act and to stand up for environmental justice communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END CRUEL IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT AGAINST KIDS
statements.title: END CRUEL IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT AGAINST KIDS
sentences: Last year, a mother and two children were detained at the Van Nuys Courthouse after a judge dismissed their asylum case.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
statements.title: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am here today because we have yet to see a bill offered on the floor during my time in Congress that would make life more affordable for working families.
In fact, since the last time my freshmen colleagues and I were on this floor talking about the Republicans' affordability crisis, Donald Trump unconstitutionally started a war with Iran.
After just over 2 weeks, Donald Trump's war in Iran has cost the American people $11 billion.

I recently conducted a survey of nearly 70,000 constituents in my district and asked them a simple yes-or-no question: Instead of the war in Iran, should Trump focus on making the cost of living more affordable?
Donald Trump's war in Iran has the worst-ever support for a war at its start.
Trump's reckless and illegal war with Iran is yet another example of how this administration has been out of touch with the priorities of American families since he has been back in office.
The American people want the Epstein files released.
Since the war in Iran started, prices for gas, food, and other essentials have spiked.
Experts believe that Trump's war in Iran could push the average cost of gas to above $4 a gallon within weeks.
He is more concerned about lining the pockets of his billionaire donors and starting wars to deflect from the issues people actually care about.
We all voted against Trump's war in Iran, to stop him from abusing his power.
Gas prices are nearly $3.50 per gallon on average across the country, but experts believe Trump's war in Iran could push the average cost of gas to above $4 a gallon within weeks.
Diesel prices are up 86 cents to $4.60 per gallon, and jet fuel prices have skyrocketed, hiking prices for shipping and airfare.
Working families in Los Angeles and across the country cannot afford Trump's war.
It is adding up quickly, but then they turn on the TV and see that Trump has unconstitutionally started a war in Iran without strategy or justification.
Already, the cost of this war could have likely paid for extending the Affordable Care Act tax credits this year.
Additionally, nearly 11,000 people in California's 29th District will lose access to health coverage because of Republicans' refusal to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits.
The Kaiser Family Foundation estimates that annual out-of-pocket premium payments for ACA marketplace enrollees will increase from $888 in 2025 to over $1,900 in 2026.

He started a war because he once again refuses to address the issues Americans actually care about: releasing the Epstein files, reining in ICE, and addressing the affordability crisis he and Republicans started.
They want to be able to afford their rent, pay for their groceries, see their doctor, and fill their tank without fear of going into debt.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FUNDING FOR LOS ANGELES
statements.title: FUNDING FOR LOS ANGELES
sentences: CIRCLE is a 24/7 unarmed response program that sends a team of mental health professionals and individuals to address nonurgent LAPD calls relating to the homeless population.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to bring these resources that will improve mental health and address substance abuse within the homeless population.
As challenges continue to plague our country, including climate disasters and health-related threats, it is important that we understand how STEM can be used to solve these issues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP THE REPUBLICAN AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
statements.title: STOP THE REPUBLICAN AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
sentences: There are bills that have been introduced that stop price gouging at the grocery store, make housing more affordable, and make healthcare accessible for all, but Republicans have yet to take up any of these proposals.

Over the past year, Republicans chose to rename the Gulf of Mexico, redefine what a showerhead is, rename the Kennedy Center, look into annexing Greenland, regulate fridges and gas stoves, and perhaps the most egregious one is to make the largest cuts to healthcare in our country's history in order to give billionaires more tax breaks.

With the big, ugly bill, Trump and Republicans have implemented the largest cuts to healthcare in the history of our country and worsen the affordability crisis just to line the pockets of their billionaire donors.
Republicans turn their backs on making life affordable for our most vulnerable in order to help billionaires afford another yacht.

My House Democratic Caucus freshmen colleagues and I are focused on making life better for the American people and driving down grocery prices, utility bills, rent and mortgage payments, and childcare and elder care costs so that hardworking people can breathe easier.
To help working families, especially multigenerational households, deal with the rising costs of living, I am introducing the Multigenerational Family Tax Credit Act.
This includes upgrades like grab rails in the shower, an additional bathroom or bedroom, or even assistance to go up and down stairs.

We broke it; we bought it.'' When the big, ugly bill was being marked up in the Natural Resources Committee, I led an amendment that would make this unserious proposal more beneficial for working families in my district.
Under direct orders from the President, the big, ugly bill ignored the concerns of a majority of Americans to instead cater to billionaires.
For over a year, Republicans have done nothing to save Medicaid, protect immigrant communities, provide food for needy families or children, or address the skyrocketing cost of living.
Republicans voted to stand with billionaires and make life harder and more expensive for working families.
House Democrats all voted to save Medicaid and SNAP, protect our immigrant communities, and stand with working families across the San Fernando Valley and across the country.
They live on a fixed income from Social Security.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
statements.title: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
sentences: Earlier today, the House voted to pass Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries' bill to extend the Affordable Care Act's enhanced premium tax credits for 3 more years.
House Democrats have been fighting for months to save these critical tax credits and for years to protect the Affordable Care Act from Republicans' constant attacks.
The ACA tax credits are the reason that record numbers of Americans have health insurance today.

The ACA tax credits lower monthly premiums and make coverage realistic for working families, small business owners, seniors not yet eligible for Medicare, and people who fall through the cracks of employer-based insurance.

Over the past year, instead of working on meaningful solutions to lower the cost of groceries, lower the cost of housing, or protect healthcare, Republicans chose to rename the Gulf of Mexico, redefine what a showerhead is, rename The Kennedy Center, look into annexing Greenland, and regulate fridges and gas stoves.
Trump is entertaining entering another war with Venezuela.
Republicans chose to shut down the government instead of extending the ACA tax credits to help Americans afford healthcare.
During the longest shutdown in government history, my colleagues and I heard from our constituents about how Republicans' inaction to extend the ACA tax credits would impact them.

In my district, the San Fernando Valley in Los Angeles, nearly 31,000 people would have seen their healthcare costs rise if the ACA tax credits expired, and nearly 11,000 people would have lost access to healthcare entirely.
I am proud to have voted with my colleagues to pass Leader Jeffries' bill to extend the ACA tax credits and protect healthcare, but our work is not done.
Mr. Speaker, I thank my colleagues who participated in this Special Order hour on the ACA tax credits.
The Affordable Care Act tax credits are why our country has a record-high number of insured people.
Because of the ACA, they can have reliable healthcare that covers her husband's preexisting conditions.
Angel and her husband are two of the over 31,000 people in my district who will see their healthcare costs rise if the ACA tax credits are not extended.
I also have two kids who are on Medi-Cal.'' Families of four like this woman's will be forced to pay over $6,000 more this year if the ACA tax credits are not extended.
The Affordable Care Act tax credits keep healthcare affordable for all Americans.
Families are still facing high costs for housing, childcare, groceries, and other everyday necessities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 6703, LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 498, DO NO HARM IN MEDICAID ACT; PRO
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 6703, LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 498, DO NO HARM IN MEDICAID ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R...
sentences: Republicans have been in the majority and in control for this whole year, yet they have not put forward a bill that helps working families with the rising cost of living or to prevent hardworking Americans' healthcare premiums from skyrocketing in price.

If Republicans were serious about helping their constituents and addressing the healthcare crisis that they manufactured with the big, ugly bill, they would join Democrats and vote to extend the ACA tax credits for 3 years.
I will vote ``no'' on this rule and the underlying bill to protect my over 31,000 constituents who rely on these ACA tax credits to make their healthcare affordable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: KAYLA HAMILTON ACT
statements.title: KAYLA HAMILTON ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, H.R. 4371 goes against our core values as a country, and I urge all my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BENJAMIN GUERRERO-CRUZ IS HOME
statements.title: BENJAMIN GUERRERO-CRUZ IS HOME
sentences: I will continue showing up to detention facilities to hold ICE and this administration accountable for the terror that they are forcing families to live through each day.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
statements.title: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
sentences: This is why I introduced the INFORM Act.

With my Hispanic Caucus and Progressive Caucus colleagues, I will continue showing up to detention facilities and working with my colleagues to hold ICE accountable, promote government transparency, and respect the dignity of immigrant families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IS HERE
statements.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IS HERE
sentences: Artificial intelligence is here, and it is reshaping nearly every aspect of modern life: how we work, how we learn, and how we communicate.
AI-generated content is becoming more prevalent in healthcare, housing, education, entertainment, and even public service.
If we do not have a standardized plan to become proficient in AI literacy today, we will not be ready to handle the challenges that AI can pose in the future.
This is why I am introducing the AI for ALL Act.
That is why I introduced the INFORM Act.

I will continue showing up to detention facilities and working with my colleagues to hold ICE accountable, promote government transparency, and respect the dignity of immigrant families. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HAPPY BIRTHDAY TO CALIFORNIA
statements.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY TO CALIFORNIA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, happy birthday to the greatest State in the Union.
Mr. Speaker, 175 years ago, California was admitted as the 31st State in the Union.
Generations of immigrants, workers, dreamers, and innovators have propelled California forward and made it a beacon for the rest of the Nation.
For 175 years, immigrants, workers, dreamers, and innovators made California a leader in the country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE IS OUT OF CONTROL
statements.title: ICE IS OUT OF CONTROL
sentences: The INFORM Act brings transparency to ICE's decisionmaking process and fights for the dignity of detainees.
This is why I introduced the INFORM Act.
I will keep fighting and seeking justice for Benjamin, his family, and all immigrants. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICANS ARE PUTTING FORWARD A RESOLUTION THAT TARGETS LOS ANGELES
statements.title: REPUBLICANS ARE PUTTING FORWARD A RESOLUTION THAT TARGETS LOS ANGELES
sentences: However, instead of putting a resolution on the floor that helps Angelenos address the cost of living, save their Medicaid, or protect our city's immigrant communities from the Trump administration's cruelty, Republicans are putting forward a resolution that targets Los Angeles, our home, and Californians.

The resolution that we are voting on this week is a political stunt to distract from this administration's terrorization of hardworking families and immigrant communities that are a huge reason why our city, our State, and our country are great.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank Leader Jeffries and Chair Ledger Fernandez for hosting this important discussion on the disastrous impact Republican cuts to Medicaid would have on women and children across the country.
In the middle of the night, Republicans on the Rules Committee will consider a bill that contains the largest cuts to Medicaid in our country's history.
This outright assault on healthcare will result in 13.7 million Americans losing their health coverage, including many of the 370,000 Medicaid beneficiaries in my district.
I also heard from Joe from Panorama City who, without the help of Medicaid, would not be able to afford medical treatments for his children.
Cutting Medicaid will be a disaster for families across the country.
I stand with my House Democratic Caucus colleagues in protecting it from Republicans' cruel and extreme budget. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT MEDICAID
statements.title: PROTECT MEDICAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as we speak, House Republicans are finalizing an extreme budget plan that includes the largest cut to Medicaid in our country's history.

Additionally, hospitals like Olive View Medical Center in Sylmar, where over 70 percent of patients rely on Medicaid, will suffer, and services at health centers throughout my district, including El Proyecto del Barrio and Northeast Valley Health Corporation will be cut.
Republicans' attacks on Medicaid means Americans, including millions who are already struggling to keep up with the rising cost of living, will be forced to pay more for healthcare.
Republicans continue to show that they have no plans to make life easier for anyone who is not a billionaire.
In fact, while the rest of the country gets sicker and poorer, Republicans are set to give their billionaire donors new tax breaks.
Protecting Medicaid is essential to our communities.

I call on my Republican colleagues to join House Democrats in signing our discharge petition to protect Medicaid for their constituents and healthcare for children, seniors, and the disabled in their district.

Some of the projects that these funds would have supported include giving middle school students opportunities to use math and design to address agricultural issues; identifying the use of deepfakes and curbing the spread of misinformation; and supporting and training the next generation of quantum technicians.
Instead, we are fighting to save it from the chaotic, reckless, and destructive actions of this administration. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GULF OF AMERICA ACT
statements.title: GULF OF AMERICA ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, there are many issues that we could be talking about today, like lowering the cost of living, protecting Medicaid and Social Security, or protecting immigrant communities.
I am disappointed that House Republicans blocked my amendment to this bill that would actually help working families across the country.
It was not just the House Republicans who opposed helping working families.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this ridiculous bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CO
statements.title: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL STANDARDS; HEAVY-DUTY...
sentences: Strong vehicle standards protect Americans from expensive and volatile fossil fuels and accelerate the adoption of cleaner vehicle technologies to help us compete globally.
Not only are Republicans taking away healthcare from over 370,000 of my constituents who rely on Medicaid, they are actively worsening the health problems many of them face.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
statements.title: TRUMP IMMIGRATION POLICIES
sentences: Donald Trump is blatantly pushing aside the Constitution and the rule of law to deport anybody at will.
I am here because I am fighting for my mother and many like her who came to this country in search of a better life.
I am fighting so our immigrant communities can, once and for all, live without fear that their livelihoods would be taken away at a moment's notice.
I am fighting with my Congressional Progressive Caucus and Congressional Hispanic Caucus colleagues against this administration's attempts to strip away a person's right to due process.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELON MUSK TAKEOVER
statements.title: ELON MUSK TAKEOVER
sentences: This billionaire was neither elected by the American people nor Senate confirmed.

Yet, he is sitting in our Nation's highest office, openly seizing power, making consequential decisions about Americans' personal data, and gutting the services and programs that working families in the San Fernando Valley rely on.
We are supporting litigation, and we are mobilizing.
I urge my Republican colleagues to join us in the fight against Elon's takeover. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
statements.title: CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
sentences: If my constituents need assistance, I encourage them to reach out to my office, and we will be able to start advocating on their behalf to get the Federal resources that they need.
That is why I am committed to working with our local, State, and Federal officials to make sure our community has the resources that it needs to rebuild stronger.
Our community is strong and resilient, and we will help each other come back from this disaster. ____________________
